Publication of Prospectus to Support Historic Warrants and Convertible Securities, Exercise of Warrants and Total Voting Rights
BSF Enterprise P
LC
(LSE: BSFA), (OTCQB: BSFAF), the biotechnology company focused on developing tissue engineering, lab-grown materials and bioactive solutions, is pleased to announce that the Financial Conduct Authority has approved the Company's prospectus dated 08 September 2026 (the "Prospectus").
The Prospectus provides a formal, long-term regulatory framework to facilitate the potential exercise of existing warrants and convertible instruments over the coming 12 months, ensuring orderly headroom for the Company's ongoing commercial scale-up.
The Prospectus has been prepared in connection with the proposed admission to the Equity Shares (Transition) Category of the Official List of the Financial Conduct Authority and to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange of new Ordinary Shares which may be issued pursuant to the exercise of certain existing warrants and/or the conversion of existing convertible securities, as further described in the Prospectus.
Exercise of Warrants and Admission
The Company has received a notice of exercise in respect of 100,000 warrants at an exercise price of 1 penny per Ordinary Share.
Accordingly, the Company will issue 100,000 new ordinary shares of £0.01 each in the capital of the Company (the "New Ordinary Shares").
Application has been made for the New Ordinary Shares to be admitted to the Equity Shares (Transition) Category of the Official List and to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange.
It is expected that Admission will become effective and dealings in the New Ordinary Shares will commence at 8.00 a.m. on 11 September 2026.
The New Ordinary Shares will, on Admission, rank pari passu in all respects with the existing Ordinary Shares, including the right to receive all dividends and other distributions declared, made or paid following their issue.
Total Voting Rights
Following Admission, the Company's issued share capital will comprise 203,849,437 Ordinary Shares of £0.01 each, each carrying one voting right. The Company does not hold any Ordinary Shares in treasury.
Accordingly, following Admission, the total number of voting rights in the Company will be 203,849,437.
This figure may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they determine whether they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules.
Availability of the Prospectus
A copy of the Prospectus is available on the Company's website at
www.bsfenterprise.com
.
A copy of the Prospectus will also be submitted to the National Storage Mechanism and will be available for inspection at the FCA's National Storage Mechanism.

latest.content:

Lab-Grown Leather for Ultra-Luxury Automotive & Advanced Robotics Skin
BSF Enterprise Plc (LSE: BSFA), (OTCQB: BSFAF), the biotechnology company focused on tissue engineering, lab-grown materials and bioactive solutions, is pleased to announce that it has executed a Heads of Terms where certain provisions are legally binding, establishing a Strategic Partnership with SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH ("SCHAKAU").
The partnership establishes a targeted commercial framework focused on two high-value growth pillars:
1. Luxury Automotive & Bespoke Materials: Rapid commercialisation of BSF's Lab-Grown Leather portfolio (including the T-Rex Leather™ concept) across bespoke, ultra-luxury programs with leading European automotive manufacturers.
2. Robotics Skin & Biological Human Interface Technologies: Industrial adoption of BSF's bio-engineered human skin equivalents and biological interface materials for humanoid and industrial robotics applications.
Key Highlights:
●
Direct Access to Leading European Luxury Automotive OEMs and Tier-1 Decision-Makers:
Establishes direct commercial conduits into ultra luxury vehicle manufacturers and specialised automotive engineering programs, targeting immediate 1-of-1 bespoke interior accents and trim applications.
●
Next-Generation Robotics Interfaces:
Leverages 3D Bio-Tissues' proprietary tissue-scaffolding technology to supply bio-engineered human skin equivalents as biological surface layers for humanoid and industrial robotic systems.
●
Performance-Aligned 6-Year Commercial Model:
The agreed commercial framework provides for a revenue share on SCHAKAU-originated programmes. Pre-SOP commercial revenues participate in the revenue share upon receipt but do not commence the six-year period.
Following First Commercial Production, the baseline revenue-share percentage per program (as agreed at that time) applies in full for Years 1-3, reducing to 50% of that percentage for Years 4-6, after which the revenue share ceases.
●
Performance-Based Equity Incentives:
The commercial framework contemplates a milestone-based equity and option programme, with any option or warrant vesting being 100% performance-contingent against defined commercial milestones
●
Strategic Capital Introduction Framework:
Capital introduced by SCHAKAU attracts a success fee of 5% up to £10m, 4% from £10m-£25m, 3% from £25m-£50m and 2% above £50m, payable in cash or equity on completion.
●
100% IP Ownership Retained
: BSF (via subsidiaries 3D Bio-Tissues Ltd and Lab-Grown Leather Ltd) retains absolute, 100% ownership of all underlying patents, scaffolds, trade secrets, and cell-manufacturing workflows.
●
Opportunity-Specific Exclusivity:
SCHAKAU will have exclusivity in respect of commercial opportunities introduced by it and acknowledged or deemed acknowledged under the Heads of Terms, subject to agreed protections for BSF's pre-existing relationships and an inactivity mechanism allowing BSF to withdraw exclusivity from a specific target following 180 consecutive days without substantive commercial interaction.
Pillar 1: Luxury Automotive & OEM Expansion
Through SCHAKAU's established industry network, BSF is positioning its Lab-Grown Leather (LGL) platform directly within the ultra-premium automotive sector. Initial commercialisation will focus on high-margin, bespoke interior trim, steering elements, and luxury accents (under BSF's proprietary T-Rex Leather™ hallmark).
This bespoke approach enables BSF to generate early commercial traction and high-margin product revenue without requiring immediate large-scale industrial manufacturing infrastructure, while establishing direct relationships with key design and materials decision-makers at tier-1 automotive brands.
Pillar 2: Biological Human Interface Technologies for Robotics
Extending from 3D Bio-Tissues' core tissue-engineering capabilities - previously demonstrated through its continuous tissue-scaffolding production workflows - BSF is advancing its technology into the rapidly emerging robotics sector.
As humanoid and specialised robotics progress toward complex industrial and domestic environments, traditional synthetic outer layers present performance limitations. BSF's platform enables the production of bio-engineered human skin equivalents-advanced biological surface layers designed to provide natural flexibility, structural compatibility, and seamless bio-interface integration.
By applying tissue engineering at scale, BSF aims to establish its biological materials as a premier surface interface option for global robotics OEMs seeking advanced biological material integration.
Commercial Milestones
The Heads of Terms establish performance milestones targeting a binding MOU for the development or licensing of Lab-Grown Leather products during September to December 2026 and a binding MOU with a Tier-1 partner for Robotics Skin / Biological Interface development during September 2026 to January 2027.
Executive Commentary
Che Connon, Chief Executive Officer of BSF Enterprise PLC, commented:
"
This strategic partnership represents a significant step in converting our platform science into high-value commercial channels. Entering the ultra-luxury automotive sector gives us direct communication with decision-makers who define luxury craftsmanship, allowing us to commercialise our lab-grown leather in bespoke vehicle programs.
"Simultaneously, extending our tissue-scaffolding technology into biological interface materials for robotics opens a vast new market opportunity. By applying our expertise in bio-engineered human skin equivalents, we are positioning BSF at the intersection of biotechnology and advanced robotics. We have built a commercial framework that protects our IP while giving our partner every incentive to secure major OEM contracts.
"
Nico Schakau, Managing Director of SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH, added:
"
For more than two decades, we have worked at the intersection of engineering, advanced materials and the automotive industry. But some ideas have the potential to reach far beyond the industries in which they begin.
We believe biological materials could fundamentally change the way humans and machines interact. As humanoid robotics becomes part of our everyday world, the interface between human and machine will matter just as much as the intelligence within it. Tissue engineering opens the door to an entirely new generation of biological interfaces - more natural, more adaptive and ultimately more human.
Lab-grown leather gives us an extraordinary opportunity to demonstrate what this technology can achieve today. Robotics gives us a glimpse of what it could become tomorrow."

latest.content:

BSF Enterprise PLC

Company

Worldwide Exclusive Commercialisation of ETSYL
®
in Luxury Cosmetics & Skincare
BSF Enterprise PLC (LSE: BSFA), the biotechnology company focused on developing tissue engineering, lab-grown materials, and bioactive solutions, is pleased to announce that it has executed Heads of Terms establishing a worldwide, exclusive commercialisation and supply partnership for its proprietary bioactive peptide, ETSYL
®
(INCI: palmitoyl pentapeptide-87), with SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH ("SCHAKAU").
Under the terms executed, key provisions including global market exclusivity, 100% intellectual property retention, and confidentiality are legally binding upon signature. SCHAKAU has been granted exclusive global commercialisation, distribution, and licensing rights for ETSYL
®
across the cosmetics, skincare, dermocosmetics, and luxury beauty sectors for an initial target-linked term of 10 years.
Key Transaction Highlights:
●
Exclusive 10-Year Global Term:
SCHAKAU receives exclusive worldwide rights in cosmetics and luxury beauty for an initial 10-year period, strictly conditional upon achieving agreed annual commercial volume targets following an initial 12-month ramp-up period.
●
Funded Commercialisation:
SCHAKAU has allocated a dedicated market development budget estimated at
€300,000
to fund clinical claim substantiation, regulatory compliance, brand creation, and international distribution capital.
●
Downstream Expenses:
SCHAKAU is solely responsible, at its own expense, for all finished consumer product notifications (including CPNP/SCPN portal filings), Cosmetic Product Safety Reports (CPSR), Responsible Person (RP) representations, and clinical efficacy testing.
●
Direct Supply Revenue Stream & Expected Timing:
BSF will supply compliant bioactive ETSYL® under a structured, dose-based volume schedule, securing commercial manufacturing margins for BSF's 100% subsidiary, 3D Bio-tissues Ltd. Initial raw material supply revenues are expected during the 12-month product compilation phase ahead of retail launch.
●
50:50 Third-Party Licensing Split:
Net licensing income from third-party brand integrations will be split 50:50, after deducting external compliance and international patent prosecution and maintenance costs, directly protecting BSF's historical and ongoing patent investments.
●
100% IP Retention:
BSF retains absolute ownership of all patents, trade secrets, manufacturing know-how, and underlying technology related to ETSYL
®
.
Background on ETSYL®: Unlocking Portfolio Value in Cosmetics
ETSYL
®
(palmitoyl pentapeptide-87) represents a high-value commercial derivative from BSF's core tissue engineering R&D program. Originally developed in-house by BSF's 100% subsidiary, 3D Bio-tissues Ltd, to accelerate cell growth and stimulate natural collagen synthesis within tissue scaffolding for lab-grown products, the bioactive peptide demonstrated high biological activity in extracellular matrix production.
Recognising the growing global market demand for scientific, clinically backed bioactive peptides in high-end anti-ageing cosmetics, BSF identified ETSYL
®
as a high-margin commercial spin-off. By leveraging 3D Bio-tissues' proprietary bio-manufacturing workflows, BSF can produce ETSYL
®
at scale, serving as a raw bioactive supplier to the skincare market without diverting capital from its core tissue engineering and leather applications.
Partner Profile: SCHAKAU & The HANDS OF GOD Ecosystem
SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH, led by founder Nico Schakau, is a boutique commercialisation firm specialising in brand scaling, luxury positioning, and high-value industrial partnerships. SCHAKAU leads market development, brand creation, and global commercialisation within the luxury beauty and dermocosmetics space.
SCHAKAU is deploying ETSYL
®
as the core active ingredient in its flagship ultra-luxury skincare brand, HANDS OF GOD, featuring a high-potency skin serum ("E-L-Y-S-Y-L"). Under the partnership, SCHAKAU will drive both direct consumer product deployment via HANDS OF GOD and broader B2B ingredient licensing to global cosmetic brand partners.
Executive Commentary
Che Connon, Chief Executive Officer of BSF Enterprise PLC, commented:
"ETSYL® is a prime example of the deep value embedded across BSF's biotechnology portfolio. Originally engineered by our team at 3D Bio-tissues to boost natural collagen generation for our lab-grown tissue structures, its ability to stimulate skin cell matrix production made its application in luxury skincare an excellent added commercial bonus.
By partnering with Nico and the team at SCHAKAU, we have established a capital-light, highly scalable model. SCHAKAU is funding downstream clinical, regulatory, and brand launch costs, allowing BSF to capture manufacturing supply revenues and 50% of global licensing income, while retaining 100% ownership of our core patent stack. This transaction validates our strategy of converting platform science into non-dilutive commercial cash flows."
Nico Schakau, Managing Director of SCHAKAU Managementberatung GmbH, added:
"We are delighted to enter into this long-term global partnership with BSF Enterprise PLC. We firmly believe in the long-term and sustainable growth of the longevity sector, and that the next generation of luxury skincare will be defined not simply by branding, but by science, measurable efficacy and truly differentiated bioactive technologies. ETSYL® embodies precisely that ambition. Beginning with HANDS OF GOD, we intend to establish ETSYL® as a globally recognised ingredient hallmark for advanced bioactive skincare and to build an international commercial ecosystem around the technology over the coming decade.
Our ambition is simple: turn exceptional science into a global icon.
Summary of Key Commercial Terms
Feature
Terms
Scope
Worldwide exclusive rights in cosmetics, skincare, and luxury beauty.
Binding Status
Exclusivity, IP ownership, and interim commercial protections are legally binding upon signature.
Duration
Initial 10-year exclusive term, subject to mutually agreed annual volume targets.
Launch Capital
Estimated €300,000 dedicated launch budget by SCHAKAU for clinicals, regulatory, and marketing.
Revenue Timing
Initial raw material supply revenues expected during 12-month launch preparation phase.
Regulatory Division
BSF supplies raw bioactive material CoAs/SDS/REACH; SCHAKAU funds finished CPSR, PIFs, CPNP/SCPN filings, and clinical claims.
Licensing Income
50:50 net income split after deducting compliance and patent defense expenses.
Supply Pricing
Tiered volume-based dose schedule (Launch, Growth, Scale bands).

latest.title: Heads of Terms - US Joint Venture
latest.content:
Today 07:00
RNS Number : 8751O
BSF Enterprise PLC
03 August 2026
3 August
2026
BSF Enterprise PLC
("BSF" or the "Company")
Heads of Terms Executed for US Joint Venture
& High-Profile US Event Launch for T-Rex Leather™
BSF Enterprise PLC (LSE: BSFA), the tissue engineering company, is pleased to announce that it has entered into a non-binding Heads of Terms ("HoT") with US-based brand operator IMPOSTER LLC ("IMPOSTER") to establish a Joint Venture Company ("JVCO"). The proposed partnership provides a capital-efficient, de-risked route for BSF to commercialise its proprietary T-Rex Leather™ in the lucrative North American luxury market, while fully preserving the Company's independent commercial rights across primary global volume categories.
Key Highlights:
●
US Market Entry & Event Activation:
Enables immediate Phase 1 marketing, showcasing and customer pre-orders for T-Rex Leather™ goods across premier US high-net-worth events, including the Hampton Classic Horse Show (August 2026), New York Fashion Week (September 2026) and the Humane World Gala (November 2026).
●
Defined Commercial Scope:
JVCO will focus exclusively on small luxury novelty goods, bag charms, keyrings, desk accessories, equestrian sporting goods and a limited showcase run of bespoke handbags and wallets.
●
Retention of Core Commercial Rights and IP:
BSF retains 100% of all IP, commercial and distribution rights for high-volume categories, including mainline footwear, apparel, automotive interiors and mass-market handbags, preserving complete freedom to execute independent partnerships with global Tier 1 luxury houses.
●
Zero Cash Capital Contribution from BSF:
BSF will contribute core technology licensing and material supply access but zero cash capital to JVCO. Full Phase 2 commercial operation and product exclusivity are strictly conditional on IMPOSTER successfully providing ring-fenced operational funding of $500,000 to $1,000,000 to JVCO (drawn from IMPOSTER's planned $3.5 million growth capital raise).
●
Multi-Stream Revenue Generation:
BSF targets multi-stream cash generation, including a contemplated 25%-35% gross margin on raw T-Rex Leather™ material transfers, an anticipated ingredient royalty of 3%-7% on net sales and a 50% share of downstream JV profits.
●
Proven US Luxury & Event Leadership:
JVCO will be led by Jaclyn Sharp as CEO, alongside Valerie Angeli overseeing US Operations & Event Strategy and Simon Whitehouse as Strategic Luxury Adviser. This team brings deep North American networks across luxury retail, high-net-worth equestrian circuits, and ethical brand activations.
Phased Activation & Targeted US Marketing
Under the terms of the agreement, BSF (via its wholly owned subsidiary, Lab-Grown Leather Ltd) and IMPOSTER will form a 50/50 joint venture entity. To capture near term commercial momentum, the agreement establishes a two-phase rollout:
1.
Phase 1 (Immediate Activation):
Grants JVCO a targeted marketing and event license to deploy T-Rex Leather™ showcase items at major US luxury activations starting in August 2026. This initiative targets ultra-high-net-worth consumers, equestrian lifestyle markets and ethical luxury buyers in North America.
2.
Phase 2 (Full Exclusivity Activation):
Full commercial category exclusivity will activate upon IMPOSTER closing its broader growth financing and transferring dedicated ring-fenced operational funding into JVCO.
Retained Intellectual Property & Supply Terms
BSF retains 100% ownership of all underlying patents, scaffold workflows and core cellular technology. BSF will act as the exclusive material supplier to JVCO under a cost-plus model (25%-35% gross margin), ensuring manufacturing cash flows to BSF independent of downstream JV profitability. All finished goods will carry the mandatory hallmark
"Crafted with T-Rex Leather™"
to build brand equity in North America.
Dedicated US Management & Commercial Execution
The JVCO board and executive team bring extensive domain expertise to accelerate market entry in North America. Under the leadership of
Jaclyn Sharp (CEO), Valerie Angeli (Director of US Operations & Event Strategy), and Simon Whitehouse (Strategic Luxury Adviser),
JVCO gains immediate access to established networks in luxury fashion, high-net-worth equestrian sports and animal welfare organizations to drive commercial pull-through for T-Rex Leather™. IMPOSTER LLC brings dedicated brand building capability, deep ethical-luxury positioning, and established relationships across US animal welfare organisations and luxury retail channels. Partnering with IMPOSTER provides BSF with immediate operational firepower and targeted market access in North America without diluting BSF's internal management focus on core technology scaling.
Che Connon, Chief Executive Officer of BSF Enterprise, commented:
"This agreement represents an exciting step forward in our strategy to build commercial traction in the lucrative North American market. Partnering with IMPOSTER gives us an immediate, funded platform to showcase T-Rex Leather™ directly to high-net-worth individuals and luxury buyers at events like the Hampton Classic and New York Fashion Week - without committing BSF cash capital. Crucially, by limiting the JV scope to targeted luxury accessories, we preserve total freedom to execute direct commercial deals with major global fashion and automotive brands across our primary categories."
Jaclyn Sharp, Founder & CEO of IMPOSTER, commented:
"T-Rex Leather™ represents exactly the kind of material innovation that IMPOSTER was built to champion - proof that luxury no longer requires compromise. Partnering with BSF gives us the opportunity to bring the world's most extraordinary bio-fabricated material to the US luxury market at a moment when the industry is actively searching for what comes next. We're proud to help lead that shift."
Transaction Conditionality Disclaimer
The proposed Joint Venture remains subject to completion of mutual due diligence, execution of definitive legally binding documentation, satisfaction of funding conditions precedent, and customary board and regulatory approvals. Further updates will be provided to the market as definitive agreements are finalised.
